propositions: Add a 7th link relation caused_by expressing that a bug was caused by another ticket/change, making bug provenance a first-class graph edge.
caused_by is directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, and intentionally Jira-unmapped, following the discovered_from precedent as a purely additive change.
The hardcoded non-blocking tuple in _graph.py (~line 204) must include caused_by or it falls to the else-branch and wrongly gets blocking-cycle semantics.
The relation string is duplicated across schema, generated types, _links.py, unlink.py, help text, MCP writes, and golden CLI-help snapshots, all requiring updates.
Old LINK events and the reducer stay valid with no persisted data rewritten; legacy relations still reduce without error.
A caused_by two-node cycle is allowed and a caused_by edge does not appear as a blocker in ready/graph traversal.
